title: Hudson Hot Air Affair

services.name: Ballooning Education Program
services.desc: This is an optional flight. This means that if the balloons are able to fly at the morning launch, pilots can participate in the 3:00 flight at their discretion. However, if the balloons are not able to fly in the morning (and if weather permits) there will be a mass ascension flight at 3:00 pm. This is an event highlight! Inflations and flights are weather dependent. Hot air balloon flying is never guaranteed. Balloon rallies like Hudson Hot Air Affair require good weather conditions for balloon flights. If the balloons are not able to fly, please remember there is so much more to do in Hudson. Enjoy the other Hudson Hot Air Affair events or check out the Hudson Area Chamber of Commerce

services.name: Kids Ice Fishing Contest
services.desc: Ice fishing at the Perch Lake Road Boat Launch, 497 Perch Lake Road. Equipment and mentors on site. Giveaways for all the participants. Limited parking at Perch Lake, please take the shuttle to the site from Carbone’s Pizzeria/Willow River Saloon (1106 County Road A, Hudson, WI). Sponsored by Carbone’s Pizzeria/Willow River Saloon and The Empourium, in cooperation with St. Croix County Alliance of Sportsman’s Clubs, St. Croix County Parks and Fleet Farm.
